topic: SpaceX sued by states over Grok AI deepfake images
title: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok AI image tool
dek: Attorneys general in the two states allege violations of consumer protection laws tied to nonconsensual images created by the company's AI system.
body:
Attorneys general from Oregon and Virginia filed lawsuits against SpaceX on November 23, 2026. The suits focus on the Grok AI tool and its role in generating certain types of images.

The complaints state that the tool has been used to produce nonconsensual intimate imagery and deepfakes. They also claim the company gave users inaccurate information about how the system handles safety features. Grok Imagine is specifically named as the feature that can create sexualized images from user prompts.

## What the lawsuits allege

Consumer protection laws exist to keep companies from misleading the public about products and services. In these cases, the states argue that users were not given clear details about the risks of creating fake images of real people without permission. Deepfakes are images or videos made by artificial intelligence that can appear realistic even when they show events that never occurred.

The lawsuits seek measures to limit the spread of such content. They do not detail specific penalties but aim to require changes in how the tool operates. SpaceX has not issued a detailed public response to the filings.

## Growing attention to generative AI

Generative AI refers to systems that produce new text, images, or other material based on patterns learned from large data sets. As these tools become more common, regulators in various places have started to examine how they can be used to create content that affects personal privacy. Similar legal actions have begun in other areas as well.

The current cases add to existing legal questions surrounding Elon Musk's technology projects. Ordinary users may notice more warnings or restrictions on AI image tools as companies respond to these developments. The outcomes could shape how generative AI is offered to the public in the future.
